<documents>
<document id="support-financial-abuse">
IfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoneyˆIfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney,ˆpressuringˆyouˆtoˆhandˆitˆover,ˆorˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆyou'reˆnotˆalone,ˆandˆweˆcanˆhelp.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆsafelyˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆwhenˆit'sˆsafe.ˆYouˆcanˆuseˆaˆcodeˆphraseˆlikeˆ"Iˆneedˆtoˆtalkˆaboutˆmyˆaccountˆsecurity"ˆifˆsomeoneˆmightˆseeˆyourˆscreen.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆareˆtrainedˆtoˆhelp.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆsignˆoutˆotherˆdevicesˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆreplaceˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆStopˆsendingˆpaperˆmailˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆ-ˆTalkˆaboutˆoptionsˆforˆmovingˆmoneyˆyouˆneedˆtoˆkeepˆsafeˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆwon'tˆdoˆWeˆwon'tˆtellˆanyoneˆelseˆyouˆcontactedˆus.ˆ##ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆimmediateˆdanger,ˆcallˆemergencyˆservicesˆfirst.ˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆfasterˆwhenˆyouˆtellˆusˆit'sˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-password-reset">
ResettingˆyourˆpasswordˆIfˆyouˆforgotˆyourˆpassword,ˆyouˆcanˆresetˆitˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ##ˆResetˆyourˆpasswordˆ1.ˆTapˆForgotˆpasswordˆonˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆemailˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆresetˆlink.ˆ3.ˆOpenˆtheˆlinkˆonˆtheˆsameˆphone,ˆconfirmˆtheˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆtextˆyou,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆnewˆpassword.ˆTheˆlinkˆexpiresˆafterˆanˆhour.ˆIfˆitˆhasˆexpired,ˆstartˆagain.ˆ##ˆDidn'tˆgetˆtheˆemail?ˆCheckˆspamˆandˆmakeˆsureˆyouˆenteredˆtheˆemailˆyouˆsignedˆupˆwith.ˆIfˆyouˆnoˆlongerˆhaveˆaccessˆtoˆthatˆemail,ˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆForˆyourˆsecurity,ˆchangingˆtheˆemailˆonˆanˆaccountˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆinˆtoˆneedsˆextraˆchecks.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆresetˆOtherˆdevicesˆareˆsignedˆout.ˆTheˆfirstˆtimeˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆIfˆyouˆdidn'tˆaskˆforˆaˆresetˆemail,ˆsomeoneˆmayˆhaveˆtypedˆyourˆemailˆbyˆmistake.ˆIfˆyouˆalsoˆseeˆaˆsign-inˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize,ˆseeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccount".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
